summary: Make Follow relocate the conversation's real execution root through one backend-owned transaction: the provider, the durable pointer, the drift baseline, dependent surfaces and every client move together, or nothing does.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: React Native/iOS Follow action after the shared contract lands on main

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android Follow action after the shared contract lands on main

automated: npm run typecheck passed for main and renderer; eslint --max-warnings=0 passed on every changed TypeScript file, which is what the pre-commit hook runs on staged files.
npm test passed 384 files / 3,724 tests with 3 skipped. Every commit on this branch went through the repository pre-commit gate, which runs the same suite.

tests/unit/execution-root-coordinator.test.ts drives the transaction against a fake host and pins the paths a live registry makes hard to reach: rollback after a failed target start, a failed rollback reported separately, a rollback when the conversation row vanished before the commit, the revision changing during async validation, a second relocation refused while one holds the thread, and queue/supersede/drop behaviour around a turn boundary.
tests/unit/execution-root.test.ts pins machine-aware and Windows-safe containment and rebasing, including that /repo/app-old is not inside /repo/app.
tests/unit/execution-root-db.test.ts pins that the revision is bumped in the same statement as the pointer, and that both accessors resolve a rotated Claude session id to the root conversation.
tests/unit/terminal-cwd-execution-root.test.ts is a source guard over all seven terminal-creation entry points, so a NEW entry point that reads projectPath fails the suite.
notExercised: Nothing here has been exercised in the running app. No human has clicked Follow against a real worktree, and no provider has actually been stopped and restarted at a new cwd by this code path.

Claude and Codex continuity is reasoned from their existing resume preflights, not observed: Claude re-runs ensureClaudeSessionResumable against its session cwd before every query, and Codex re-sends the cwd on every turn/start. Neither has been confirmed against a live session after a relocation.
The OpenCode continuity-unsupported refusal has not been exercised against a live OpenCode server.

Remote relocation over an SSH-tunnelled backend has not been exercised. The renderer no longer drops remote drift suggestions, and the request routes on threadId, but no remote session has been followed.

EXISTING terminal panes are NOT yet reconciled. New terminals open in the followed worktree, but a shell already open stays where it is; the shell integration markers and the pane-move rules are outstanding. No pane is written to, so nothing regresses.

Drift evidence is not yet revision-aware, and command classification still treats any absolute path in a shell command as evidence. A drift check that started before a relocation can still publish against the old root, and reading a file in another worktree can still be read as movement.
React Native/iOS and native Android have no Follow action. Android still renders drift as a passive notice and mobile still ignores the event; both are unchanged, so nothing unflagged ships there.
